entries.keywords: capital city zimbabwe harare
entries.a: The capital city of Zimbabwe is Harare. Bulawayo is the second biggest city.

entries.keywords: independence day zimbabwe 1980 april freedom
entries.a: Zimbabwe became independent on 18 April 1980. We celebrate Independence Day every year on 18 April.

entries.keywords: public holidays zimbabwe heroes day unity day workers africa day
entries.a: Some national days: Independence Day (18 April), Workers' Day (1 May), Africa Day (25 May), Heroes' Day (second Monday of August), Defence Forces Day (the day after Heroes' Day) and Unity Day (22 December).

entries.keywords: victoria falls mosi-oa-tunya smoke thunders zambezi waterfall
entries.a: Victoria Falls is on the Zambezi River. Its local name is Mosi-oa-Tunya, 'the smoke that thunders'. It is one of the biggest waterfalls in the world and a World Heritage Site.

entries.keywords: great zimbabwe ruins stone house shona kingdom enclosure
entries.a: Great Zimbabwe is a ruined stone city near Masvingo. 'Zimbabwe' comes from dzimba dzemabwe or dzimba-hwe, 'houses of stone'. It was built by the ancestors of the Shona people and our country is named after it.

entries.keywords: flag colours colors zimbabwe green yellow red black white star bird
entries.a: The Zimbabwe flag has seven stripes (green, yellow, red, black, red, yellow, green), a white triangle, a red star and the Zimbabwe Bird. Green is for farming and land, yellow for minerals, red for the blood shed in the struggle, black for the people, and the star for hope and peace.

entries.keywords: zimbabwe bird soapstone national symbol great zimbabwe carved
entries.a: The Zimbabwe Bird is a carved soapstone bird found at Great Zimbabwe. It is on our flag and coat of arms as a symbol of the nation.

entries.keywords: official languages zimbabwe sixteen 16 shona ndebele english tonga kalanga venda
entries.a: Zimbabwe has 16 official languages, including English, Shona, Ndebele, Chewa, Kalanga, Nambya, Ndau, Shangani, Sotho, Tonga, Tswana, Venda, Xhosa and Zimbabwean Sign Language.

entries.keywords: provinces zimbabwe how many ten 10 mashonaland matabeleland manicaland midlands masvingo
entries.a: Zimbabwe has 10 provinces: Harare, Bulawayo, Manicaland, Mashonaland Central, Mashonaland East, Mashonaland West, Masvingo, Matabeleland North, Matabeleland South and Midlands.

entries.keywords: rivers zimbabwe zambezi limpopo save runde
entries.a: Big rivers of Zimbabwe: the Zambezi (north), the Limpopo (south), and the Save (east). Lake Kariba, on the Zambezi, is one of the biggest man-made lakes in the world.

entries.keywords: lake kariba dam hydro electricity zambezi
entries.a: Lake Kariba was made when the Kariba Dam was built on the Zambezi River. It makes hydro-electric power for Zimbabwe and Zambia.

entries.keywords: highest mountain nyangani nyanga zimbabwe peak
entries.a: The highest mountain in Zimbabwe is Mount Nyangani in the Eastern Highlands near Nyanga. It is about 2 592 metres tall.

entries.keywords: national parks wildlife hwange mana pools matobo gonarezhou safari big five elephants
entries.a: Famous places for wildlife: Hwange National Park (famous for elephants), Mana Pools, Matobo Hills (balancing rocks and rhinos) and Gonarezhou. Zimbabwe has all of the Big Five animals: lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo and rhino.

entries.keywords: national anthem song zimbabwe simudzai mureza blessed be the land
entries.a: Our national anthem is 'Blessed Be the Land of Zimbabwe'. In Shona it is Simudzai Mureza weZimbabwe, in Ndebele Kalibusiswe Ilizwe leZimbabwe.

entries.keywords: money currency zimbabwe zig dollar usd bond notes coins
entries.a: Zimbabwe uses the ZiG (Zimbabwe Gold) and many shops also take US dollars. Money rules change, so ask a grown-up what is used today.

entries.keywords: food sadza traditional dish relish nyama muriwo maize meal
entries.a: Sadza (also called isitshwala in Ndebele) is the main food of Zimbabwe. It is made from maize meal and water and eaten with relish like muriwo (vegetables) or nyama (meat).

entries.keywords: mbira thumb piano music instrument shona hosho ngoma
entries.a: The mbira is a Shona thumb piano played with the thumbs. Other traditional instruments are the hosho (rattles) and the ngoma (drum).

entries.keywords: national animal sable antelope zimbabwe
entries.a: Zimbabwe's national animal is the sable antelope.

entries.keywords: hunhu ubuntu values respect kindness community unhu
entries.a: Hunhu / Ubuntu means 'I am because we are'. It teaches respect, kindness, sharing and helping others. In Shona: munhu munhu navanhu. In Ndebele: umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu.

entries.keywords: proverb proverbs shona ndebele saying wise
entries.a: A Shona proverb: Chara chimwe hachitswanyi inda - 'one thumb cannot crush a louse'. It teaches that working together gets things done.

entries.keywords: heroes acre monument national hero harare
entries.a: National Heroes' Acre is a national monument near Harare that honours people who served the country.
